content.json:
# Claude usage — gateway view

Usage for every Claude client routed through API Management: **Claude Code**, **Claude Desktop**, and anything else calling `/anthropic`. Sourced from `ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog` joined to `ApiManagementGatewayLogs`.

Attribution requires the gateway policy to stamp `x-caller-oid` and `x-caller-upn`, and the API diagnostic to log them. Without both, every row reads `anonymous`.

parameters.name: Client
parameters.label: Client
parameters.query:
let rates = datatable(Model:string, InPer1M:real, OutPer1M:real)[
    "claude-opus-5",   15.0, 75.0,
    "claude-opus-4-5",  5.0, 25.0,
    "claude-sonnet-5",  3.0, 15.0,
    "claude-haiku-4-5", 1.0,  5.0
];
let gwBase = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where Url has "/anthropic"
    | extend OidReq  = tostring(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-oid"]),
             OidResp = tostring(ResponseHeaders["x-caller-oid"]),
             RawUpn  = tostring(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-upn"]),
             UA      = tostring(RequestHeaders["User-Agent"])
    | extend Oid = iff(isempty(OidReq), OidResp, OidReq)
    | extend Client = case(UA has "claude-cli", "Claude Code",
                           UA has "claude-desktop", "Claude Desktop",
                           isempty(UA), "Unknown",
                           "Other");
let ids = gwBase | where isnotempty(RawUpn) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RawUpn) by Oid | project Oid, KnownUpn = RawUpn;
let gw = gwBase
    | join kind=leftouter ids on Oid
    | extend User = case(isnotempty(RawUpn), RawUpn, isnotempty(KnownUpn), KnownUpn, isnotempty(Oid), Oid, "anonymous")
    | project CorrelationId, TimeGenerated, ResponseCode, Method, Url, BackendTime, TotalTime, User, Oid, Client, UA;
let usage = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | extend Model = iff(isempty(ModelName), "", replace_regex(ModelName, @"-\d{8}$", ""))
    | join kind=inner (gw) on CorrelationId
    | extend IsInference = TotalTokens > 0
    | lookup kind=leftouter rates on Model
    | extend EstCost = (PromptTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(InPer1M, 0.0)
                     + (CompletionTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(OutPer1M, 0.0);
gw | summarize by Client | order by Client asc

## Claude usage at a glance

Every request through the gateway, attributed to the developer who made it.

content.query:
let rates = datatable(Model:string, InPer1M:real, OutPer1M:real)[
    "claude-opus-5",   15.0, 75.0,
    "claude-opus-4-5",  5.0, 25.0,
    "claude-sonnet-5",  3.0, 15.0,
    "claude-haiku-4-5", 1.0,  5.0
];
let gwBase = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where Url has "/anthropic"
    | extend OidReq  = tostring(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-oid"]),
             OidResp = tostring(ResponseHeaders["x-caller-oid"]),
             RawUpn  = tostring(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-upn"]),
             UA      = tostring(RequestHeaders["User-Agent"])
    | extend Oid = iff(isempty(OidReq), OidResp, OidReq)
    | extend Client = case(UA has "claude-cli", "Claude Code",
                           UA has "Electron" and UA has "Claude/", "Claude Desktop",
                           UA startswith "Bun/", "Claude Desktop",
                           isempty(UA), "Unknown",
                           "Other");
let ids = gwBase | where isnotempty(RawUpn) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RawUpn) by Oid | project Oid, KnownUpn = RawUpn;
let gw = gwBase
    | join kind=leftouter ids on Oid
    | extend User = case(isnotempty(RawUpn), RawUpn, isnotempty(KnownUpn), KnownUpn, isnotempty(Oid), Oid, "anonymous")
    | project CorrelationId, TimeGenerated, ResponseCode, Method, Url, BackendTime, TotalTime, User, Oid, Client, UA;
let usage = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | extend Model = iff(isempty(ModelName), "", replace_regex(ModelName, @"-\d{8}$", ""))
    | join kind=inner (gw) on CorrelationId
    | extend IsInference = TotalTokens > 0
    | lookup kind=leftouter rates on Model
    | extend EstCost = (PromptTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(InPer1M, 0.0)
                     + (CompletionTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(OutPer1M, 0.0);
usage | where Client in ({Client}) or '*' in ({Client})
| summarize Requests = count(), Tokens = sum(TotalTokens), Developers = dcount(Oid),
            Cost = round(sum(EstCost), 2), Success = round(100.0 * countif(ResponseCode == 200) / count(), 1)
| project Metric = pack_array("Requests", "Tokens", "Developers", "Success rate %"),
          Value  = pack_array(Requests, Tokens, Developers, Success)
| mv-expand Metric to typeof(string), Value to typeof(real)

             RawUpn  = tostring(BackendRequestHeaders["x-caller-upn"]),
             UA      = tostring(RequestHeaders["User-Agent"])
    | extend Oid = iff(isempty(OidReq), OidResp, OidReq)
    | extend Client = case(UA has "claude-cli", "Claude Code",
                           UA has "Electron" and UA has "Claude/", "Claude Desktop",
                           UA startswith "Bun/", "Claude Desktop",
                           isempty(UA), "Unknown",
                           "Other");
let ids = gwBase | where isnotempty(RawUpn) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RawUpn) by Oid | project Oid, KnownUpn = RawUpn;
let gw = gwBase
    | join kind=leftouter ids on Oid
    | extend User = case(isnotempty(RawUpn), RawUpn, isnotempty(KnownUpn), KnownUpn, isnotempty(Oid), Oid, "anonymous")
    | project CorrelationId, TimeGenerated, ResponseCode, Method, Url, BackendTime, TotalTime, User, Oid, Client, UA;
let usage = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | extend Model = iff(isempty(ModelName), "", replace_regex(ModelName, @"-\d{8}$", ""))
    | join kind=inner (gw) on CorrelationId
    | extend IsInference = TotalTokens > 0
    | lookup kind=leftouter rates on Model
    | extend EstCost = (PromptTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(InPer1M, 0.0)
                     + (CompletionTokens / 1000000.0) * coalesce(OutPer1M, 0.0);
gw
| summarize Requests = count(), Users = dcount(Oid), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserAgent = iff(isempty(UA), "(none sent)", UA), Client
| order by Requests desc
